description: List the organization's website folders (the groups the dashboard files sites into), each with its folder_id, name and how many websites it holds. Use a folder_id or name with move_websites_to_folder, or a folder_id with list_websites to see one folder's sites. Folders belong to the account that created them: a key sees the folders of the member who created the key.
name: list_folders
title: List folders
